query: What reasons or compliance risks appear in declined expenses?

per_column.name: asset_type_category
per_column.rationale: Describes what kind of asset/item the expense concerns, not a reason for or compliance risk in the decline. Asset type is an attribute of the expense, potentially correlated with declines, but not a constitutive aspect of 'why it was declined'.

per_column.name: provisioning_mechanism
per_column.rationale: How the asset/record was provisioned (auto_generated, manual, etc.) is a process origin attribute. It may predict decline likelihood but is not itself a decline reason or compliance-risk facet.

per_column.name: resource_purpose_intent
per_column.rationale: The business purpose of the resource characterizes the expense, not the reason it was declined. Purpose is an aspect of the expense, not of the decline-reason concept.

per_column.name: departmental_context
per_column.rationale: Department is a grouping/context dimension that duplicates an existing original column and is an external segmentation, not an aspect of the reason a given expense was declined.

per_column.name: documentation_completeness
per_column.rationale: Missing or incomplete documentation is a genuine compliance-risk / decline-reason aspect. This is arguably an 'aspect of' why an expense is declined, so it partially realises the concept.

per_column.name: travel_asset_flag
per_column.rationale: A boolean derived from asset/purpose type; it re-encodes information already in asset_type_category/resource_purpose_intent and characterizes the expense, not the decline reason. Overlaps with those columns.

judge.rationale: The concept to decompose is 'declined_expense_reasons' -- the constitutive facets should be the categories of WHY expenses are declined or the compliance-risk dimensions (e.g., policy violation, missing/incomplete documentation, amount/threshold breach, duplicate submission, unauthorized category, approval-chain failure, out-of-policy vendor/timing). Only documentation_completeness maps onto such a facet. The remaining columns describe attributes of the expense itself (asset type, provisioning mechanism, purpose, department, travel flag) -- these are external predictors or restatements of the expense, not parts of the decline-reason concept. Mutual exclusivity is low because asset_type_category, resource_purpose_intent, and travel_asset_flag overlap in encoding asset/purpose information, and departmental_context duplicates an original column. Exhaustiveness against the actual decline-reason concept is very poor since nearly all principal reason/risk facets (policy breach, threshold, duplication, authorization) are absent.
